approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
first_installment_sketch: UNKNOWN. The benchmark matrix (BASELINE vs PARALLEL vs CACHE vs SPECULATIVE vs COMBINED) has no measurements in the corpus yet. First installment drafts only after a measured run; the spec forbids publishing the matrix shape with made-up numbers.
inputs: a measured execution benchmark run across the matrix
the failure cases and wasted work from the same run
name: EXECUTION BENCHMARK
outputs: one benchmark report with the full metric table
the baseline definition so future runs are comparable
purpose: Never market execution optimizations as ideas; measure BASELINE vs PARALLEL vs CACHE vs SPECULATIVE vs COMBINED and publish the numbers including failures.
template: Matrix arms: BASELINE vs PARALLEL vs CACHE vs SPECULATIVE vs COMBINED. Metrics per arm: wall time, critical-path time, tool calls, useful calls, wasted speculative calls, tokens, model cost, cache hit rate, retries, failure rate, result equivalence, recovery time. Then publish failures too: what each optimization broke or wasted. Frame: speculation, parallelism, caching and durable execution are replaceable optimizations under the mission/evidence model, and the benchmark is the proof.
